VBO:0200424.summary: The Dakotah Shepherd name is linked to Triple M Kennel’s developing cross of English Shepherd, Border Collie and Kelpie ancestry. An early keeper account records a foundation litter born in February 2004, before the program had its name. The report describes a stage in the type’s development, without establishing a shared temperament.
